summary: Full end-to-end test of Deliwifi billing RT/RW-Net app (backend pytest suite + Playwright UI on public preview URL). Backend: 30 tests across auth/roles, dashboard overview, paket CRUD, pelanggan lifecycle (create/isolir/aktif/hapus + auto login account), tagihan generate/mark-paid/delete + income journal, voucher generate/assign/batches, agen CRUD + penjualan komisi 10%, keuangan expense CRUD, pengaturan (brand/midtrans/mikrotik/genieacs) + mikrotik test, portal pelanggan (invoices, WiFi SSID/pass validation), pembayaran mode simulasi (invoice + voucher publik), akses kontrol & 401/403 guards. 29/30 pass; only failure is the missing brute-force lockout (playbook requirement). Frontend: verified admin login + all 8 admin pages, create/isolir/aktifkan/hapus pelanggan, paket add/edit/nonaktif/hapus, generate tagihan + Lunas (Tunai) reflected in Keuangan, generate+assign voucher & all 4 filter tabs, tambah/hapus agen, catat/hapus pengeluaran with correct laba bersih, pengaturan save+persist+MikroTik test (mode simulasi message), portal pelanggan (status/paket/tagihan, bayar simulasi -> lunas, ubah SSID/password WiFi persisted), portal agen (jual voucher -> komisi Rp300, riwayat, income di admin), publik /beli (order -> bayar simulasi -> kode voucher), register tab -> 'Akun Belum Terhubung', role guards (pelanggan blocked from /admin, agen blocked from /portal), logout. All core billing flows work end-to-end in simulation mode as designed.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / rate limiting: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 and the account can still log in immediately (playbook expects lockout/429 after 5 fails)

allow_origin_regex=r'https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True reflects ANY origin; with httpOnly SameSite=None cookies this allows cross-site credentialed requests. Use explicit origin allowlist from env.
Response includes plaintext pppoe_password (and customer doc stores it plaintext). Acceptable for PPPoE ops but should at least be admin-only/documented; consider not returning it in list endpoints.
Invoices whose customer was deleted show customer_name '-' and remain orphaned (paid ones cannot be deleted). Consider cascading or archiving invoices when a customer is deleted.
Loads up to 200k/20k transactions into memory and aggregates in Python; will not scale. Use MongoDB $match/$group aggregation with date filters.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without try/catch and without awaiting; when clipboard permission is denied it throws an unhandled rejection (CRA dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText... permission denied' covered the whole page and blocked the 'Beli Lagi' button), yet the success toast 'Kode disalin' is still shown (misleading). Wrap in try/catch with a textarea fallback and only toast on success.
Purchase is triggered only by clicking the whole Card (div, no role/tabindex, no visible CTA button). Not keyboard accessible and no obvious 'Beli' action for users.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext calls GET /api/auth/me on every load for anonymous visitors, producing 401 console errors on public pages. Skip the call (or suppress) when no token/cookie exists.
JWT is stored in localStorage ('deliwifi_token') in addition to the httpOnly cookie, re-exposing the token to XSS. Rely on the httpOnly cookie only (withCredentials) unless Bearer is required.

issues: Page scrolls horizontally: the chart card ('Pemasukan vs Pengeluaran') has right edge at 480px vs 390px viewport (document scrollWidth 480). Chart container needs min-width:0 / responsive wrapper.
Recharts console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render — set explicit min height/aspect on ResponsiveContainer.
Transaction table (452px) requires inner horizontal scroll and cells wrap to 3 lines; consider a card list layout on small screens.

action_items: Add brute-force protection to POST /api/auth/login (lock/429 after 5 failed attempts per email/IP with cooldown) — currently no lockout at all.
Tighten CORS: explicit allowed origins (env-driven) instead of allow_origin_regex 'https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True.
Fix clipboard copy on /beli: await navigator.clipboard.writeText inside try/catch with fallback; only show 'Kode disalin' on success.
Add a visible, keyboard-accessible 'Beli' button on hotspot package cards in /beli.
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on admin dashboard chart card (min-w-0 on chart wrapper).
Skip GET /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors on public routes to remove 401 console noise; drop JWT from localStorage and rely on httpOnly cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS wildcard regex + credentials is the highest-risk item; combine with SameSite=None httpOnly cookie means any site can call the API with the user's session.
auth.py: no login attempt throttling; also no password strength rule beyond length>=6 and no lockout/audit log.
routes_admin.py overview()/list_transactions(): full-collection fetch + Python filtering (to_list(200000)) — move to aggregation pipelines with date range $match.

seed.py: voucher DEMO01 seeding contains a no-op update ({'$set': {}}) and slicing logic that is hard to follow; simplify. seed_admin correctly updates the password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (verified: hash is $2b$).
Deleting a customer removes the user + customer doc but leaves invoices/transactions dangling (invoice list shows '-'); decide cascade or soft-delete.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional; 2 UI bugs + 3 design issues found

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env, conftest provides admin_client/pelanggan_client/agen_client). Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v (pytest.ini already sets -n 2 --dist loadscope). Note: EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD — use @qadeliwifi.com for synthetic emails. Test-created data must be cleaned with tests/cleanup_test_data.py afterwards (paid invoices cannot be deleted via API). Known expected simulation behaviours: mikrotik ops return applied=false with 'mode simulasi' reason, /api/payments/* returns {simulated:true} and /api/payments/simulate/* completes payment. Only known backend failure: TestHealthAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (feature not implemented).
rca_of_the_issue: Clipboard bug: BeliVoucherPage.jsx line 98 fires navigator.clipboard.writeText(code) synchronously in the onClick and immediately toasts success; the promise rejection (NotAllowedError when clipboard permission is denied/headless) is unhandled, triggering the webpack dev-server error overlay iframe which intercepts pointer events on the whole page (verified by Playwright: click on buy-again-button blocked by #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay). Brute-force gap: auth.py login() has no attempt counter/lockout — verified 6 wrong passwords all return 401 and a valid login immediately succeeds.
